apps.localizedDescription: unc0ver is the long-running semi-untethered jailbreak by pwn20wnd for iOS 11.0 through 14.8.1. Its final 5.2.0 release covers the widest firmware range of the classic jailbreaks, installing Cydia or Sileo depending on the chosen bootstrap, and it stays useful for the 32-bit era iPhones and iPads that are otherwise stuck without a package manager.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA from pwn20wndstuff/Undecimus. Development stopped with version 5.2.0 (June 2020), which is the build served here — it covers iOS 11.0 – 14.8.1 depending on the device. Sign with your own certificate and keep in mind that free certificates expire after seven days, after which the app must be re-signed to re-apply the jailbreak.
